t270:
Fix consumer lag on the ad-impression topic. The Kotlin consumer in `impressions-ingest` is falling ~2M messages behind during evening peaks.
- `ImpressionListener.onMessage` currently does one JDBC insert per record. Switch to batch listening and `JdbcTemplate.batchUpdate` with chunks of 500.
- Raise `max.poll.records` and tune `fetch.min.bytes` in `application.yml`.
- Move the campaign lookup out of the per-record path into a Caffeine cache with a 5 min TTL.
- Keep at-least-once semantics and commit offsets only after the batch is written.
Acceptance: sustained 40k msg/s on the load-test configuration with lag under 10k, and the existing Testcontainers integration tests still pass.
